sheets.title: Assumptions, definitions & how to use this workbook

items.definition: Özge_S26_Registrations_ALL.xlsx → Sheet1 (629 form submissions).
One registrant per email (lower-cased, trimmed); earliest submission kept → 603 unique.
08 Raw Data = untouched Sheet1 + four grey [calc] duplicate-check columns. 08b = untouched Sheet2 (456-name contact list, not used in the dashboards).
Education, university, major, internship and self-reported source shortened to English; English-form answers merged with their Russian twins.

Age at registration = DATEDIF(birthdate, registration date). Birthdates are self-entered; ages < 14 or > 70 (typos such as the current year, or 1900) are blanked and counted as invalid in 05 · C. Other high ages are kept and flagged as outliers.
Multi-select field. Counts are 'mentions', so shares add up to more than 100%. 'None' = «Не участвовал(-а)».
Channel comes from utm_source | utm_medium | utm_content via the 09 Channel Map (last-click, as recorded by the form).
bio_ig and rassylka come from the recruitment_f26 campaign links but converted into Özge registrations — kept as separate channels.
No UTM parameters. The attribution matrix (05 · E1) shows what these people self-reported.

'How did you hear' is mapped to a comparable group in 09 Channel Map (table D). 'Self-report confirms UTM' = share of a group's regs whose answer points to the same group; n/a where no comparable answer exists (e.g. Email, Partners).
Rename a channel or change its group in 09 Channel Map (yellow cells). Charts & tables update after recalculation.
Channel (or segment) registrations ÷ all unique registrants.
Herfindahl index = Σ share². 1 = everything from one source. Effective # of channels = 1 / HHI.
(day total − mean daily total) ÷ st.dev. ≥ 1.5 is flagged as a spike.
Share of a channel's volume that arrived on its single best day. ≥ 50% = Burst; active ≥ 60% of days = Always-on.
Q1 − 1.5·IQR and Q3 + 1.5·IQR (Tukey rule).
Channel metric minus campaign average, in percentage points.
Every dashboard number is a live COUNTIFS / AVERAGEIFS formula on 07 Cleaned Data via named ranges (Formulas → Name Manager).
Paste new de-duplicated rows under 07 Cleaned Data, copy the grey formula columns down, then extend the c_* named ranges.
Channels with n < 10 give unstable % metrics — read their quality columns with caution.
